title: Three-Player Triangle Passing
description: Three players pass in a continuous triangle with no dribbling allowed, forcing quick decisions and accurate footwork on every catch.

content.objective: Move the ball quickly and accurately around a triangle with no dribble to bail out a bad catch.
content.setup: Three players form a triangle roughly five metres apart, one ball to start.
instructions: Pass the ball around the triangle in one direction without dribbling.
Catch with both hands and pivot to face the next receiver before passing.
After one minute, reverse the direction of the passing.
Add a second ball for an advanced group, passed in the opposite direction.
coachingPoints: Catch and pivot before passing, don't just spin the ball around.
Use a strong pass, not a soft one, to keep pace.
Move feet into the triangle shape if it drifts out of position.
commonMistakes: Dribbling once out of habit when a catch is awkward.
Letting the triangle shape collapse or stretch out.
Telegraphing the pass with the eyes before releasing it.
content.safety: Keep enough room so a second group's passes don't cross this one's space.
